vBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF from GitHub issue #2566 (swarm cohort afk-wave2-2566-2581)

narratives.Description: Mirror #1527 PROJECT-DEFINITION sync for specification.xbrief.json roadmap/registry items on scope terminal transitions.
narratives.Overview: When scope lifecycle tooling completes, fails, or cancels a scope, matching plan.items entries in xbrief/specification.xbrief.json must receive the same terminal status and lifecycle metadata as PROJECT-DEFINITION sync (#1527).
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add specification-sync.ts parallel to project-definition-sync.ts.
2. Wire syncSpecificationAfterScopeMove from transition.ts after folder moves.
3. Add unit and integration tests with multiple proposed items plus completed scopes.
4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
narratives.UserStory: As a Deft operator, I want specification roadmap item statuses to agree with completed scope files, so agents do not see contradictory [proposed] labels on shipped work.

items.title: Matching spec items flip to completed on scope:complete

narrative.Acceptance: Given specification.xbrief.json contains a matching plan.items entry, when task scope:complete runs, then the item status becomes completed with updated metadata.
Given a matching specification item, when task scope:fail or scope:cancel runs, then the item status becomes failed or cancelled respectively.

references.title: Issue #2566: scope:complete leaves specification.xbrief.json roadmap item statuses stale

expected_outputs: specification item statuses sync on scope:complete, scope:fail, and scope:cancel
